description: This file defines the 'TreasuryBill' class within the 'PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet' library. It provides static methods to calculate financial metrics related to Treasury bills, such as bond equivalent yield, price, and yield, using date and discount/price inputs. The class interacts with validation methods and constants specific to financial calculations.

classes.name: TreasuryBill
classes.description: A class providing static methods to perform calculations related to Treasury bills, including bond equivalent yield, price, and yield.

methods.name: bondEquivalentYield
methods.description: Calculates the bond-equivalent yield for a Treasury bill given settlement date, maturity date, and discount rate.

methods.name: price
methods.description: Calculates the price per 100 face value for a Treasury bill given settlement date, maturity date, and discount rate.

methods.name: yield
methods.description: Calculates the yield for a Treasury bill based on settlement date, maturity date, and price.
